The new view is taken right beside the beige wall, looking along it towards the brown wall, which appears far away. Frame 209 is right up in the corner where the blue and beige walls meet. A position close to the beige wall, with the brown wall still distant, fits best near the blue–beige corner, so near Frame 209.
